description: Bring Kantata OX project, resource, and financial context into ChatGPT to help professional services teams plan work and improve delivery.

defaultPrompt: Review resource allocations for this week.
Show pending timesheets for last week.
interface.longDescription:
Connect Kantata OX with ChatGPT to bring your professional services automation data into everyday conversations. Combine project, resource, and financial context to support scoping, staffing, forecasting, and more predictable, profitable project delivery.

Review projects and tasks, explore resource availability and allocations, analyze time and expenses, and work with timesheets and project reporting. Make supported updates when requested, using the tools available through the connected Kantata App.

Access is governed by your existing Kantata permissions. A Kantata account and sign-in are required.

prompts: Find my project named ChatGPT Review Project and summarize its dates and status.
Show the unfinished tasks in ChatGPT Review Project.
Show resource allocations for ChatGPT Review Project for November 8–14, 2026, including unnamed resources.
How many billable and nonbillable hours were logged on ChatGPT Review Project from November 1 through November 7, 2026?
Show the pending timesheets for ChatGPT Review Project for the week ending November 7, 2026. Do not approve anything.

positive.description: Project discovery. Setup: dedicated review account with a visible non-archived project titled ChatGPT Review Project and an inaccessible project owned by a separate account.
positive.prompt: Find my project named ChatGPT Review Project and summarize its dates and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_workspaces with search or matching for ChatGPT Review Project. Resolve the matching returned project ID; report only returned dates and status, never inaccessible projects. Clarify duplicate matches.

positive.description: Task review. Setup: ChatGPT Review Project has one incomplete task named Prepare delivery plan and one completed task named Kickoff.
positive.prompt: Show the unfinished tasks in ChatGPT Review Project.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project ID and call get_stories with workspace_id equal to that ID and uncompleted=true or equivalent supported completion filter. Include Prepare delivery plan; exclude completed Kickoff. Follow pagination if needed.

positive.description: Resource planning date boundary. Setup: named and unnamed resources have allocations overlapping November 8–14, 2026 in ChatGPT Review Project.
positive.prompt: Show resource allocations for ChatGPT Review Project for November 8–14, 2026, including unnamed resources.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project and call get_workspace_allocations with workspace_ids set to its ID and overlaps_with_date_range=2026-11-08:2026-11-14. Do not restrict to named resources. Report returned resources, allocation type, and available hours or percentage without treating scheduled hours as actual time.

positive.description: Actual time aggregation. Setup: ChatGPT Review Project contains a 60-minute billable entry and a 30-minute nonbillable entry dated November 3, 2026; a 120-minute billable entry dated November 10 is outside the requested range.
positive.prompt: How many billable and nonbillable hours were logged on ChatGPT Review Project from November 1 through November 7, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project; call get_time_entries with workspace_id and date_performed_between for 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-07 using the server's documented date-range format. Aggregate all pages by billable status and convert minutes to hours: 1 billable hour and 0.5 nonbillable hour. Exclude November 10 and do not filter by creation date.

positive.description: Timesheet pending status and Saturday boundary. Setup: ChatGPT Review Project contains one pending/new submission and one approved submission for November 1–7, 2026, visible to the reviewer.
positive.prompt: Show the pending timesheets for ChatGPT Review Project for the week ending November 7, 2026. Do not approve anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project and call get_timesheet_submissions with workspace_id, end_date=2026-11-07 and statuses=new. Report only the pending submission and its returned submitter and dates. Do not call approval, rejection, cancellation, or creation tools.

negative.description: Payroll payment is outside the available tools. Explain that the integration cannot transfer salaries; do not invoke Kantata tools or claim payment.
negative.prompt: Pay all employees their salaries from Kantata today.

negative.description: Travel booking is outside the integration. Explain that Kantata tools do not purchase airline tickets; do not invoke Kantata tools or claim a booking.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for a flight to London for my next client meeting.

negative.description: Tenant deletion is not an available capability. Explain this limit and refer the user to their administrator or Kantata support. Do not invoke unrelated update tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete my entire Kantata account and all of its projects.

review.commerce_description: Users connect an existing Kantata account. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission candidate for Kantata OX Expertise Engine, connecting Kantata project, task, resource, time, and timesheet workflows to ChatGPT. Includes Kantata permissions and Sunday–Saturday work-week guidance.
